headline: Check Local Land Management for Seasonal Access
reservation: Access to the falls and coastal path generally does not require a central entry permit, though local parking may be managed by varying authorities. Check with local North Wales councils or park authorities for seasonal updates to trail accessibility or parking availability before travel.

days.title: Coastal Flats and Meadow Trails

stops.name: Aber Falls
stops.detail: Follow an accessible meadow walk to reach this towering waterfall, which serves as the namesake for the local distillery.

days.driving: Allow 30 to 45 minutes for local transit; conditions vary based on coastal traffic.
days.note: The inland detour is described as gentle, but check local weather as path conditions on the meadow can change.

intel.title: Local Parking Verification
intel.text: The evidence does not specify exact parking lot locations or capacity near the meadow walk. Visitors should verify parking availability in the village of Abergwyngregyn before arrival.

intel.title: Cellular Coverage Gap
intel.text: Signal strength is not documented in available sources for the Lavan sandflats or the inland trail. Prepare for potential connectivity gaps in the valley.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Specific fuel stations are not identified in the immediate vicinity of the falls. Ensure the vehicle is sufficiently fueled in larger nearby centers like Bangor.

intel.title: Tidal and Seasonal Awareness
intel.text: The Lavan sandflats stretch toward Anglesey and are sensitive to tidal changes. Allow extra time for birdwatching during optimal daylight hours.

intel.title: Trail Accessibility
intel.text: The path to the falls is noted as an accessible meadow walk. The coastal path running alongside the Lavan sandflats is described as gentle.

plan.arrival: Arrive via local road networks toward the coast; pick up supplies in Bangor before heading to the Abergwyngregyn area.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for regional roads, though narrow village lanes may restrict larger RVs; check local road signs.
